title: Linux UAPI include/uapi/linux/if_ether.h

claims_extracted.claim: Linux UAPI exposes Ethernet protocol constants including PUP, IPv4, X.25, ARP, RARP and IPv6 and defines the Ethernet header type field used for packet classification.
claims_extracted.notes: Individual constants still require registry provenance classification.

notes: Source header also preserves early Linux INET provenance comments.
